title: VA for Real Estate Investor – Skip Tracing, Cold Calling & Buyer Lists
description:
We are a growing real estate wholesaling operation looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to help us scale lead generation and day-to-day operations.

This is a long-term role for someone who wants consistent work and clear processes. You will work directly with the owner on finding motivated sellers, managing our pipeline, and supporting deal flow.

Key Responsibilities:

•  Research and build targeted lists of motivated sellers (probate, absentee owners, high-equity, etc.)

•  Perform skip tracing and verify contact information

•  Update and maintain our CRM with accurate notes, tags, and follow-up tasks

•  Assist with cold calling or texting campaigns using provided scripts (pre-qualifying leads)

•  Build and maintain our cash buyer/investor database

•  Run basic property comps and research support

•  Handle follow-up sequences via
, text, or calls

•  Prepare routine documents and support contract coordination

•  Keep our systems organized and report weekly progress

Requirements:

•  Previous experience as a Virtual Assistant for real estate investors, wholesalers, or lead generation is strongly preferred

•  Comfortable with research, data entry, and following detailed processes/SOPs

•  Good English communication skills (written and verbal)

•  Reliable high-speed internet and quiet workspace

•  Familiar with tools like Google Sheets, Google Docs, and basic CRM systems (experience with PropStream, Podio, REsimpli, or Follow Up Boss is a big plus)

•  Self-motivated, organized, and responsive

Nice to Have:

•  Experience with cold calling or lead qualification for real estate

•  Knowledge of wholesaling concepts (motivated sellers, assignment contracts, ARV/MAO basics)

•  Previous work with US-based real estate investors

Schedule & Hours:

•  20–40 hours per week (we can start part-time and scale up)

•  Flexible schedule with good overlap during US business hours preferred

•  Long-term position for the right person

Compensation:

•  $5–8 per hour depending on experience and skill level

•  Paid weekly or bi-weekly via Wise, Payoneer, or bank transfer

•  Opportunity for raises based on performance and consistency

What We Offer:

•  Clear processes and training (we will provide SOPs and Loom videos)

•  Respectful and professional working relationship

•  Consistent weekly hours once we find the right fit

•  Potential to grow into more responsibilities as the business scales (including digital marketing and web-related tasks)

How to Apply: Please reply with the following:

1.  Your experience with real estate, lead generation, or wholesaling (be specific)

2.  Which CRM or tools you have used before

3.  Your availability (hours per week and preferred working times)

4.  Your expected hourly rate

We will review applications and move quickly with short interviews and a small paid test task for the best candidates.

Looking forward to working with you!

title: Bookkeeper – AppFolio & QuickBooks Specialist
description:
Remote | Full-Time 



About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented, experienced bookkeeper with expertise in AppFolio and QuickBooks. This role supports the day-to-day accounting and bookkeeping operations for both a property management and investment rental portfolio. You must be confident working independently and communicating clearly in a remote setting.



Responsibilities



AppFolio

-Run and interpret financial reports (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow)

-Manage trust accounts in compliance with applicable regulations

-Have a complete understanding to fully handle bank reconciliations from start to finish

-Post rent payments, late fees, and other tenant charges 

-Process and manage accounts payable and vendor invoices

-Build and manage maintenance work orders

-Perform monthly bank reconciliations within AppFolio

-Review and ensure accurate accounting on owner statements

-Manage tenant and owner ledgers

-Handle security deposit tracking and dispositions

-Maintain tenant and owner portal data accuracy



QuickBooks

-Export and transfer financial data from AppFolio into QuickBooks for company financials

-Maintain accurate books in QuickBooks alongside AppFolio records

-Reconcile accounts in QuickBooks

-Assist with 1099 preparation for vendors at year-end

-Generate financial reports and budget variance analysis in QuickBooks



General Bookkeeping

-Track and manage accounts receivable and payable

-Support monthly and year-end close processes

-Maintain organized financial records and documentation

-Communicate professionally with property owners and vendors regarding financial matters

-Assist with utility billing and reconciliation



Required Skills & Experience

-Bachelors in Accounting or Bookkeeping

-Minimum of 3 years of bookkeeping experience in Quickbooks and Appfolio

-Proficient in AppFolio Property Manager — this is a hard requirement; please do not apply if you do not have AppFolio experience

-Proficient in QuickBooks for use of a property management company and residential real estate inventments

-Experience transferring or syncing data between AppFolio and QuickBooks (no API option; we have Appfolio Basic)

-Strong understanding of real estate or property management accounting

-High attention to detail and accuracy

-Able to work independently with minimal supervision

-Strong written English communication skills



Preferred Qualifications

-Familiarity with owner reporting and trust accounting

-Accounting degree or certification (not required but a plus)



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered, please include the following in your application:

- A 1-minute voice sample (Vocaroo is an option to submit this)

- Your WPM score with the 3 Minute Test:

      

- A summary of your AppFolio experience — specific tasks you have performed

- Your QuickBooks experience — Online vs. Desktop, and how long

- The Phrase Appaloosa1 in the Subject Line

- Any examples of how you have moved data between AppFolio and QuickBooks

***Applications missing any of the above will not be reviewed.

title: Bookkeeper – AppFolio & QuickBooks Operator
description:
We are not looking for a general bookkeeper.



We are hiring someone who has already been the primary bookkeeper for a property management company managing multiple owners/clients (not just one property owner that self manages)—and can step in and run this function without training.



**Non-negotiables (do not apply if these don’t apply to you):**



* Direct, hands-on experience using AppFolio in a property management company

* Proven experience as the primary bookkeeper for a company managing properties for multiple clients (not just personal portfolios)

* Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks, including setting up and back-loading properties and financials from prior years

* Formal education in bookkeeping or accounting (degree required)



**What you bring to the table:**



* Deep understanding of property management fees, owner distributions, trust accounting, and multi-owner structures

* Ability to accurately transfer and reconcile AppFolio reporting into QuickBooks

* Confidence owning the entire bookkeeping function with minimal oversight



**What success looks like:**



* Clean, accurate books across multiple properties and owners

* Trust accounts handled correctly and confidently

* Seamless systems between AppFolio and QuickBooks

* You take ownership and elevate the role—we don’t manage you



**Important:**

This is not a training role. We are looking for an expert who can hit the ground running and show us how this function should operate.



HOW TO APPLY:

1. A 1-minute voice sample (Vocaroo is an option to submit this)

2. Your WPM score with the 3 Minute Test: 
/student/tests

3. Your experience using AppFolio in a property management company

4. How you’ve handled syncing/reconciling AppFolio with QuickBooks

5. Your experience setting up or back-loading properties and financials



*Applications missing any of the above will not be reviewed.

*Generic applications will not be considered.

title: Fusion 360 Designer — CNC Custom Millwork & Cabinetry (Remote)
description:
About GavinWood LLC



GavinWood LLC is a custom cabinetry and millwork shop in Kailua, O?ahu, Hawai?i, in business since 1979. We build high-end architectural millwork, custom cabinetry, and one-off CNC-fabricated pieces for residential and commercial clients across Hawai?i.



The Role



We're looking for a Fusion 360 designer to work with us remotely, turning client specs, reference photos, and rough sketches into production-ready parametric models and CNC toolpaths — working directly with our Senior Designer.



This is design and manufacturing prep, not just renders. Every model you build has to actually run on a real 5-axis CNC router (Syntec 610MA-E5) and come out as a finished wood part.



What you'll be doing:



Building parametric Fusion 360 models from client dimensions, reference photos, and drawings — often incomplete or scattered across
s, so you'll need to interpret and ask good questions, not just plug in numbers

Setting up CAM toolpaths (2D contour, pocket/adaptive clearing, multi-pass strategies) for hardwoods, primarily white oak, on a 5-axis router

Working within — and eventually helping extend — an existing parametric toolkit we use for fast, resizable part families

Revising designs based on feedback from real test cuts on the shop floor

First Job (Trial Project)



Your first project will be a real client order: 16 custom oak vent covers for a residential job, across three repeating patterns — a square-perforated grille and two styles of linear slat grilles — plus one irregularly-shaped custom piece. You'll be building:



A parametric model per pattern family, sized to each of the 16 individual pieces

CAM toolpaths following a specific 3-pass strategy per piece: a roughing pass with a bit sized near the hole/slat opening, a small-bit pass to sharpen the corners, and a round-over pass along the top edge

Clean, organized Fusion 360 files we can hand straight to the CNC operator



It's a real job with a real delivery deadline, not a throwaway test — but it's a good, contained first project for us to see how we work together before anything longer-term.



What we're looking for

Solid Fusion 360 experience — parametric/history-based modeling and CAM (toolpaths, tool libraries, post-processing)

Comfortable working from imperfect inputs: reference photos, hand-dimensioned sketches,
 threads with corrections buried partway through them

Working knowledge of CNC machining — feeds/speeds, bit selection, what's actually machinable versus what only looks good on screen

Good written English for async coordination with the shop

Reliable and detail-oriented — this work becomes real wood parts on a real client's house



Nice to have:



Experience with architectural millwork, cabinetry, or furniture-grade CNC work

Fusion 360 API/scripting experience (Python)

Experience with multi-axis (4- or 5-axis) CNC routing

Rate & Schedule







To Apply



 Portfolio, a sample Fusion file, past CAM work, etc.

title: Meta Ads Manager, Part-Time, Ecommerce Brand (Amazon PPC experience a plus)
description:
We're a growing direct to consumer ecommerce brand, and we're hiring in advance of an upcoming scale-up phase. We want the right person in place and onboarded before that ramp-up begins, not scrambling to find someone once it's already underway.



This is a part-time role to start, with real opportunity to grow into a larger role and higher pay as our ad spend and account complexity increase.



This is not an entry-level role. We're looking for someone who can genuinely own strategy and execution on our Meta account, not someone learning on the job.



Start your application with the word "scale" as the first line, so we know you read this fully.



What you'll own:



Full management of our Meta Ads account, including campaign strategy, creative testing structure, budget allocation, and scaling decisions.

Reading and acting on performance data (CTR, CPC, cost per purchase, ROAS) to make real time optimization calls.

Working alongside our internal creative team, who handle ad asset production. Your role is strategy, structure, and spend, not creative production.

Clear weekly reporting on account performance and the decisions behind it.



Ideal, not required: experience managing Amazon PPC alongside Meta. If you've worked across both channels for a physical product ecommerce brand, we want to hear from you specifically.



What this role does not include: ad creative production, copywriting, supplier or product decisions.



Pay: $400 to $700 USD/month part-time to start, based on experience. Genuine path to a larger role and higher pay as our ad spend and account complexity scale.

Your OnlineJobs.ph profile link.

A brief overview of your Meta Ads management experience, including account sizes and spend levels you've managed, and results where you can share them.

If applicable, your Amazon PPC experience.

Your availability and time zone.

title: PM Scheduler & Customer Retention Specialist
description:
We are looking for a PM Scheduler & Customer Retention Specialist to own our preventive maintenance pipeline and keep our technicians’ calendars full. This is a production scheduling role with real sales responsibility: you will prospect new PM customers, send and follow up on PM proposals until they sign, schedule all PM and warranty work, and keep existing PM accounts happy.



You will work closely with our Customer Service Admin, who handles the main phone line, collections, repair invoices, and simple bookings when parts are already onsite. You take everything they hand off — PM leads, warranty jobs, and repairs that need parts ordered — and you own the calendar from there.



This is not a generic receptionist job. Success here means a full tech calendar (~1 week booked ahead), PM contracts signed, and PM customers retained.



What you will do every day

PM sales & retention



Identify and pursue new PM prospects: gyms, hotels, HOAs, property managers, and commercial facilities

Work warm leads handed off from Customer Service (PM LEAD packets)

Send PM contract proposals via
 and follow up persistently until the customer signs or clearly declines (target: touch every open quote at least every 5 business days)

Proactive outreach to existing PM accounts — resolve issues before contracts churn

Scheduling & calendar management



Schedule all preventive maintenance visits for signed PM contracts (commercial + residential)

Keep technicians booked ~1 week ahead — never let the calendar drop below ~3 business days of work unless intentionally left open

Schedule warranty jobs within each manufacturer’s expected timeline

Schedule parts repair jobs when parts are ordered, in transit, or marked ready in Trello (Parts Admin workflow)

Process HANDOFF packets from Customer Service — book in ServiceMinder same day (urgent) or within 24 hours (routine)

Daily workflow



Review open PM proposals due for follow-up today

Check ServiceMinder calendar density per technician

Monitor Trello Parts Admin for Phase 5 overdue cards and parts-ready jobs

Work PM compliance list for overdue commercial PM visits

Process warranty queue

Return PM retention calls/messages from the prior day

What this role is NOT

Not the primary answer on the main customer service phone line (Customer Service Admin owns that)

Not responsible for unpaid invoice follow-up or sending repair invoices

Not responsible for repair/diagnostic proposals (those are Customer Service)

Not booking simple diagnostic/repair visits when parts are already at the customer’s site (Customer Service books those)

Clear handoffs between the two roles are documented — you will know exactly what is yours vs. what gets handed off.



Tools you will use

ServiceMinder (primary — scheduling, PM proposals, customer records)

Google Sheets (PM schedule planning calendar)

Trello (Parts Admin cards, commercial PM funnel)

Gmail (PM proposals and scheduling confirmations)

RingCentral (PM prospect and retention calls — backup on main line when needed)

WhatsApp (scheduler/tech coordination)

Warranty manufacturer portals (training provided)



How we measure success

Metric Target

Tech calendar lookahead

?3 business days booked; target ~1 week

PM proposal follow-up

Every 5 business days on open quotes

PM retention issues

Acknowledge same day; resolve or escalate within 48h

Nothing silently aging past 48 hours

Weekly performance review with the owner. Metrics are tracked — this role has clear accountability.



Ideal candidate

Calendar thinker — you naturally plan ahead and hate empty technician days

Comfortable with outbound sales — PM prospecting and polite persistence on proposals without being pushy

Organized follow-up machine — you don’t let open quotes or HANDOFF packets sit

Field service or commercial PM experience a strong plus — gyms, hotels, property management, HVAC-style recurring service

Professional phone and
 communication

Comfortable learning ServiceMinder, Trello, and warranty portals quickly

Self-directed — you manage your own daily queue without being micromanaged

Accepts documented KPIs and weekly review

Reliable high-speed internet, a capable computer, and dependable availability

Willingness to take direction, apply feedback, and meet deadlines consistently

Motion graphics skills in Adobe After Effects

Thumbnail design

Experience editing finance, business, or educational channels

Familiarity with what drives YouTube watch time and retention



Details



Setup: fully remote, work from home

title: Sales Representative
description:
Join a fast-growing US online home goods retailer and enjoy the learning and opportunities that you have while working with us.



We strive to provide 5-star service & shopping assistance to all of our clients, and all of our team is accountable to fulfill this.



We are looking for a Sales Representative who can assist prospective buyers and close online ecommerce sales.



We're only looking for full-time, long-term, ongoing cooperation.



Work schedules available:

8 AM to 4 PM US EST

4 PM to 12 AM US EST



Your work week will be 5 days per week, with 2 days off per week. Days off will be selected with your manager. We will try to accommodate your preferences for which days you like, based on availability.



This role starts ASAP!!



Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Receive incoming phone calls and live chats from potential customers (prospects) who indicated that they need shopping assistance. This does not include calls and chats from existing customers that need help with their orders (that’s a job for a different department)

Makes follow-up calls, writes follow-up
s, and text messages to potential buyers. We try to follow up 5x with each person that contacted us (unless they indicate that they are no longer interested). We don’t do cold calling. Only reaching out to prospects who interacted with our online store and left their contact information.

After each interaction with a prospect/customer, writes notes & comments in our CRM (Asana)

Communicate efficiently and build rapport with potential customers

Assists prospects in their shopping journey and helps make the purchase decision

Ensures that all prospects’ questions and objections are addressed

Leads every interaction to a close sale, which means an order is placed on our online store

Prepares custom quotes, price matches competitors if necessary, and offers custom discounts. This requires calculating margins & ensuring profitability.

Answering questions about the products we offer, including technical questions. Learns the specifications, features and benefits of our bestsellers. Over time, becomes an expert in the industry.

If not able to answer product-specific questions, conducts research in the materials provided by the supplier, or reaches out to the supplier to get the information

Confirms stock availability and lead times when offering products to prospects

Documents standard procedures and best practices in a written form, so that other tea
mbers can learn from them



Requirements:

At least 2 years of experience in sales on the phone

Experience must include both inbound and outbound sales

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Experience in Customer Service on the phone is a nice to have

Experience in the e-commerce (online shopping) industry is nice to have

Home improvement, construction, and gas plumbing industry experience is a plus

Outgoing, friendly, and lively

Can-do mindset, with a sense of ownership, pride in your performance, and its impact on the company’s success

Long-term commitment - treat this as your career



What we can offer:

Sales commission: 12% of gross profit from all orders closed. Gross profit means the sale amount minus the product and shipping costs. Paid monthly. No upper limit. Monthly commission payouts range between $1,200 (the guaranteed minimum) and as high as $3,000 (for the top performer). The average monthly payout is $1,465 (average from the last 2 years).

$1,200/month minimum guaranteed pay

15 days paid days off per year (also convertible to min. guaranteed commission)

Paid training on all aspects of the role

Opportunities for professional development

Friendly atmosphere

Online Interview process

Fully remote position

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
You've worked in client service, account management, or customer retention. You’re good at keeping your accounts and clients are happy to continue working with you. You’re ready for something more now - a role where you can be a trusted advisor who makes a real difference.



You’ll join Performia Australia, part of a global Swedish HR consultancy operating in 26 countries. Our mission is to train and support business owners so they know how to identify and build productive, safe and fun teams.



Your mission is to guide our “Journey” clients through that process. You’ll be their partner, coach, and mentor. You’ll establish new clients, troubleshoot their hiring processes, and help them implement the Performia methodology. You’ll ensure they get the results they signed up for: hiring the right people and building a high-performing team.



We have a growing base of clients who have signed up for the Journey. They need hands-on support to implement the system. We need you to take full ownership of a client portfolio, proactively check in with them, and guide them to success.



The role will be challenging and requires responsibility. You will be depended on. You need to be able to take initiative and be accountable for your clients' progress. You need to be comfortable working independently and troubleshooting problems without hand-holding.



In return, you’ll receive full training on the Performia methodology and the HR industry. You’ll have the opportunity to build a professional career with a global company. You’ll work from home with a flexible, cheerful, and outcome-focused team.



You’ll be working for the Australian office, servicing the Australian clients. Even though you’ll work from home, you will have plenty of interaction every day with the rest of the team based in Australia, Philippines and China.



If you are someone who cannot work independently and you need to be around people all the time, then this role will not be right for you.



If you're ready for a role with real responsibility, you love to help others succeed, and you're looking for your chance to prove yourself and grow, apply now.



IMPORTANT INSTRUCTIONS. 



We will only consider candidates who submit their application to our candidate management system.



To submit your application - Fill out this short form. It takes 10 seconds.

title: Sales Development Representative (outbound calling)
description:
You've achieved great results in sales, appointment setting, or telemarketing. You're resilient, you don't take rejection personally, and you understand that the phone is your primary tool. You're comfortable with cold calling and know that every 'no' gets you closer to a 'yes'. But you're ready for a role where your effort is directly tied to your results.



You'll join Performia Australia, part of a global Swedish HR consultancy operating in 26 countries. Our mission is to train and support business owners so they know how to identify and build productive, safe and fun teams.



Your end goal is to fill the CEO's calendar with qualified appointments. You'll be proactively prospecting and calling a mix of warm leads, contacts from our database, and cold lists. Your job is to generate the activity that creates the pipeline. You'll qualify them, handle objections, and book them for a meeting with the CEO.



We have a strong lead database and we need you to take ownership of finding and creating opportunities. This means a significant portion of your time will be spent on cold calling and prospecting. The role will be high-volume and requires discipline and resilience.



The role will be challenging and demanding. You'll be expected to make a high volume of calls, face frequent rejection, and maintain a positive, professional attitude. You need to be able to work independently, manage your time effectively, and take full ownership of your results. This is not a role for someone who needs a warm lead handed to them.



In return, you'll be paid a base hourly rate plus a generous bonus for every qualified appointment that is kept. You'll have the opportunity to receive full training on the Performia methodology and sales process once proven your ability. You'll work from home with a flexible, cheerful, and outcome-focused team. There are significant growth opportunities for top performers.



If you are someone who cannot work independently, needs to be around people all the time, or cannot handle cold calling and rejection, then this role will not be right for you.



If you're driven and love the challenge of the hunt, apply now.



IMPORTANT INSTRUCTIONS. 



We will only consider candidates who submit their application to our candidate management system.



To submit your application - Fill out this short form. It takes 10 seconds.

title: Content & Marketing Manager (Remote)
description:
About the Business



Demi's Nails & Beauty is one of Ireland's leading beauty academies, helping beginners build successful careers through both in-person and online education.



We're entering an exciting growth phase with new programmes, digital products, YouTube, podcasts and social media expansion. We're looking for someone who is highly organised, creative and proactive to take ownership of our content workflow and help us grow our online presence.



Your Mission



Your role is to own the entire content workflow so the CEO can focus on teaching, recording content, creating new programmes and growing the business.



Success in this role means content is consistently organised, edited, scheduled and published without the CEO needing to manage every step.



Responsibilities

Content Coordination

Organise all raw video footage.

Maintain a structured Google Drive content library.

Rename and categorise files.

Coordinate with Demi & other potential video editors.

Review edited videos and request revisions.

Maintain the weekly content calendar.

Schedule approved content across platforms.

Repurpose long-form content into short-form content.

Graphic Design



Using Canva, create:

Instagram carousel posts.

Story graphics.

Course graphics.

PDFs and workbooks.

Lead magnets.

Thumbnails.

Promotional graphics.

Presentation slides.

Content Management



Manage content across:



Instagram.

TikTok.

.

YouTube.

Pinterest (future).

Podcast platforms.

Marketing Support



Assist with:



Content planning.

Campaign organisation.

Product launches.

Promotional graphics.

 campaign assets.

Performance tracking.

Researching content trends.

Competitor research.

Organisation & Systems

Keep Google Drive organised.

Maintain the content database.

Build and improve content workflows.

Create templates and checklists.

Keep ClickUp content tasks up to date.

Recommend improvements to the content process.





Essential



Excellent English.

Strong Canva skills.

Experience organising large amounts of content.

Experience coordinating content production.

Excellent organisational skills.

Strong attention to detail.

Able to work independently.

Comfortable using Google Drive.

Comfortable learning new software.



Preferred



Video editing experience (CapCut, Premiere Pro or Final Cut).

Social media management.

Basic copywriting.

Experience with ClickUp or similar project management software.

Experience working with creators or online educators.



The Type of Person We're Looking For:



You're someone who genuinely enjoys organisation.



You love bringing structure to busy businesses.



You're proactive.



You notice when something could be improved and take ownership of fixing it.



You enjoy creating systems that make life easier for others.



Most importantly, you enjoy seeing projects through from start to finish.







Application Process

If you're interested in this role, please submit the following:



Your CV.

A portfolio of any relevant work (Canva designs, social media content, graphics, content calendars, etc.).

A short Loom video (5–10 minutes).

In your Loom video, please tell us:

Introduce yourself and tell us about your background.

Why you're interested in this role.

What experience you have managing content and social media.

What software you're confident using (Canva, Google Drive, ClickUp, CapCut, Adobe, etc.).

Tell us about a time you organised a messy project or improved a workflow.

If you were hired today, how would you help free up the CEO's time over the first 30 days?

Why do you think you'd be a great fit for this role?



We'd love to get a sense of your personality, communication style and how you approach your work, so please don't worry about making the video perfect we're much more interested in getting to know you.

 Ads or Google Ads

• Probationary Period: 6 months

o Months 0–3: USD 280/month

o Performance & Total Compensation Structure:

Upon regularization, employees receive a guaranteed 13th Month Pay and at least one annual performance bonus equivalent to one month’s base salary during peak sales seasons. Additional bonuses may be granted based on company performance. When annualized, the total compensation is equivalent to approximately USD 350–380 per month.

title: Prop Firm Trader / Day Trader (FX/Crypto/Futures)
description:
Hello Traders!



Isla Capital is growing — and we’re looking for disciplined, serious traders to join our team of elite traders.



We work with experienced prop firm traders to trade evaluation and funded accounts through firms such as FTMO, Funded Elite, Alpha Capital Group, and similar platforms.



This opportunity is designed for Filipino professionals who understand prop firm rules, respect risk, and can trade with consistency and control.



Isla Capital is a structured, performance-driven, professional environment with a clear path toward higher earnings and long-term growth. Over time, this role will expand into live portfolio trading, where earning potential increases significantly. This is the place to develop into a professional trader.



What You’ll Do...



• Trade prop firm evaluation (challenge) accounts and funded accounts once evaluations are passed

• Strictly follow all prop firm rules and drawdown limits

• Maintain daily trading journals

• Provide consistent performance updates



What We’re Looking For...



• Experience trading prop firm accounts strongly preferred (or extensive live trading in lieu of prop firm experience)

• Strong risk management and discipline

• Ability to work independently

• Honest and reliable communication

• Understanding of scalping and/or day trading strategies



Compensation & Growth...



• Weekly base salary potential

• Bonus for passing evaluations / challenges

• Profit sharing on funded account payouts

• Performance bonuses based on payout milestones

• Access to in-house coaching from experienced traders

>> Upon certain milestones, we will also purchase additional prop accounts with copy trade software to multiply earnings

title: UI/UX Designer who Codes (Figma ? React)
description:
UI/UX Designer who Codes (Figma ? React) — Remote, Philippines

Full-time · Remote (Philippines) · Direct hire by the founder



ShipStampede is a multi-carrier shipping platform: merchants connect their stores, compare live rates across UPS, FedEx, USPS, DHL and more, buy labels, and track everything from one dashboard. We're a small, senior team shipping to production almost daily — and today, nobody on the team is a designer. You would be our first: you'd own how the product looks, feels, and flows, and you'd build what you design. You'll work directly with the founder and our lead engineer (also PH-based — you'll share a timezone with the person you'll collaborate with most).



What you'll do



Own product design end-to-end: take rough feature ideas and turn them into user flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity Figma designs, iterating with real user feedback.

Implement your own designs in our React + TypeScript app — components, layouts, styling, interactions — so nothing is lost in translation between design and code.

Build out our design system: our internal Radix-based component library (shadcn-style, Tailwind, Storybook) grew feature-by-feature; you'll turn it into a coherent system — tokens, spacing, typography, states, documented components.

Redesign data-dense screens — order tables, rate comparison, label purchase, dashboards — where clarity is the product. Users spend real money on every click; your job is to make the right action obvious.

Ship through the same process as everyone else: PR, CI, review, production within days.

Stack: React 19 · TypeScript · Vite · Tailwind + Radix UI (shadcn-style internal library) · Storybook · TanStack Query · React Hook Form + Zod · Figma (or convince us of something better).



Must-haves



A portfolio showing real product design — flows and decisions for web applications (ideally dashboards/data-heavy SaaS), not just visual polish. We will ask "why" about your choices.

3+ years designing web-app UI/UX with strong Figma craft (components, variants, auto-layout, prototypes).

Solid implementation skills: you build your designs in React + TypeScript + Tailwind to production quality. Our engineers handle the heavy data plumbing; you own the UI layer.

Design-system experience — built or meaningfully maintained one.

UX fundamentals for dense interfaces: hierarchy, progressive disclosure, empty/loading/error states, forms that don't fight the user.

Clear written English.

Nice to have: shipping/e-commerce domain (Shopify a plus) · accessibility beyond basics · restrained motion design · lightweight user research · comfort working alongside AI coding tools.



To apply: portfolio required (applications without one won't be reviewed), plus a short note about one design decision that was unpopular at first and right in the end. Anything in production you both designed and built moves you to the top.

title: AI-Driven Graphic Designer — She Reigns Creative
description:
Who we are

She Reigns Creative is a full-service digital marketing agency. We run a pod-based model serving 100+ clients across medspas, e-commerce, coaches, healthcare, and local business. We move fast and we build with AI at the center of everything. This is not a shop where designers spend three days nudging pixels in Photoshop.

The role

We're hiring a graphic designer who works with AI, not around it. You're someone who looks at a client's existing content, a competitor's winning ad, or a blank brief, and your first instinct is "I can recreate and improve this in 20 minutes using the right tools." You use Claude to think through concepts and direction, Higgsfield and Nano Banana (and similar models) to generate and iterate visuals, and your own design eye to make it actually good and on-brand.

The ideal person treats AI tools as a creative team they direct. You're constantly testing new models, finding faster paths, and building little systems so the next version is quicker than the last. If you also understand short-form video and AI video generation, that moves you to the top of the pile.

What you'll do



Recreate and adapt high-performing ad concepts. Pull a competitor's ad from the Meta Ad Library, deconstruct why it works, then rebuild it for one of our clients with their branding, products, and offer swapped in.

Take existing client content (photos, old graphics, brand assets) and reimagine it into fresh creative using AI generation tools, keeping it true to the client's brand.

Produce Meta and Google ad creative, social graphics,
 graphics, landing page visuals, and promotional assets across many client brands and styles.

Use Claude to develop concepts, write image prompts, and direct the work, then use Higgsfield, Nano Banana, GPT image tools, and others to generate and refine.

Work inside our brand systems. We have documented design systems and brand skills per client (colors, fonts, voice, templates) and you'll produce on-brand work from those.

Constantly improve your own process. Find faster tools, build reusable prompt setups, and document what works so the whole pod gets faster.



What we're looking for



Strong design fundamentals and taste. You know good composition, hierarchy, type, and color even when a machine generated the raw material. AI gets you 70% there; your eye closes the last 30%.

Genuine fluency (or fast-learner energy) with AI creative tools: Claude, Higgsfield, Nano Banana, GPT image generation, and whatever launches next month.

To Prioritize your application include the word Elemental in your application.

An experimental, efficiency-obsessed mindset. You'd rather find a smarter workflow than grind manually.

Ability to match many different brand styles, not just your personal aesthetic.

Comfortable working from briefs, references, and competitor examples.

Reliable communication and the ability to work async with a US-based team.

Bonus: short-form video editing and AI video generation (Higgsfield video, runway-style tools, etc.).



Tools you'll touch

Claude, Higgsfield, Nano Banana, GPT/DALL-E image tools, Canva, Adobe (Photoshop/Illustrator helpful), Meta Ads Manager and Meta Ad Library, and our internal systems.

title: EE/ECE/ME Grad? Korea's Global Trade Team Needs Your Engineering Brain
description:
[Recruitment Validity Period]

Applications are open until 3 business days from the date of the first recruitment announcement.



[Join DongYang Engineering and Build Global Business Together with Filipino Talent]

- DongYang Engineering (DYE) is an engineering-based global trading company located in Ulsan, Korea, with approximately 30 employees.

- DYE provides engineering and procurement services in the shipbuilding, offshore, plant, and wind power industries. We also support sourcing and quotation work for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products by connecting overseas buyers with domestic Korean suppliers.

- In addition, DYE works with global partners such as Schneider Electric and Emerson, supplying our partners’ materials and services to customers in Korea.

- Currently, DYE has a 3-member overseas sales team composed of Korean and Nepalese tea
mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

- DYE also plans to expand its overseas sales and global operations team with a focus on Filipino talent. Therefore, this position offers future opportunities to grow into a team leader or management role.



[About the Position]

- We are looking for an Electrical & Electronics Inquiry / Quotation ERP Data Assistant.(Entry~Experienced Level)

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.



[Company Introduction Materials]

- Company Introduction Video:

youtu.be/zCExthh9pzc?si=EkDCs7pqN6WylsWP

- Company
 Page:

www.
/dongyangeng



[Responsibilities]

- Check overseas buyer inquiries registered in the ERP program

- Review product information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products

- Organize product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, supplier information, and quotation terms

- Enter organized information into each required field in the ERP system

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

- Additional explanations from a tea
mber who understands the current workflow



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

1. Eligible Career Level

- This position is open to both entry-level/junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Entry-level or junior candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to help them adapt to our internal systems, work process, and operational standards.



Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



2. Payment Terms

- Payment Term: Monthly basis

- Probationary Period: 6 months



3. Salary Guideline for Entry-Level and Junior Candidates

- For entry-level candidates or candidates with limited related experience, the probationary salary will follow the company’s internal guideline below.

- Months 0–3: USD 280/month

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month

- Subject to satisfactory performance evaluation after the first 3 months.

The probationary period may be shortened if the employee demonstrates fast work adaptation and receives an excellent evaluation. This has occurred in multiple past cases.



4. Salary Guideline for Experienced Candidates

- Candidates with 3 or more years of relevant practical experience may apply as experienced candidates.

- For experienced candidates, the contracted monthly salary may be considered up to USD 450/month, depending on the candidate’s work experience, practical capability, technical understanding, communication skills, and overall fit for the position.

- Experienced candidates will also be subject to a 6-month probationary period. During the probationary period, salary will be paid according to the following structure.

- Months 0–3: 90% of the contracted monthly salary

- Months 4–6: 100% of the contracted monthly salary

- For example, if the final contracted monthly salary is set at USD 450/month, the employee will receive USD 405/month during Months 0–3 and USD 450/month during Months 4–6.

- The final contracted monthly salary will be determined after reviewing the candidate’s relevant experience, job understanding, work capability, sense of responsibility, communication skills, and overall fit with the company’s internal standards.



[After Regularization]

- Annual contract renewal is standard after regularization.

- Salary adjustments may be made based on performance, teamwork, and overall evaluation.

- If overall performance, including work capability, teamwork, reliability, and internal evaluations, is considered outstanding, - salary increases may be granted within a shorter period. This has occurred in multiple past cases.

- Exceptional performance may also lead to early promotions or salary increases prior to the annual review.



[Perks & Benefits]

1. Regular Employee Benefits

- 13th Month Salary provided

- 10 additional paid leave days upon regularization

2. Performance-Based Incentives

- Additional incentives may be provided during high-performance business periods or when performance is excellent.

- Incentives are reviewed based on work attitude, responsibility, consistency, and overall contribution.

3. Paid Holidays

- January 1st, New Year’s Day, and Christmas Day are paid holidays.

- This applies to both probationary and regular employees.

4. Long Service Incentive Program

- 1 Year Service: PHP 17,000

- 3 Year Service: PHP 22,500

- 5 Year Service: PHP 28,000



[How To Apply for the job]

Just Fill out 10 Simple Questions through Google Form






Interview via google meet will be conducted after first screening and candidates will be notifed to their
s or
 



[Closing Message]

This position plays an important role in accurately organizing overseas buyer inquiries and domestic supplier quotations for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products in the ERP system.



If you have a background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field, and you can handle documents and data carefully, you can successfully adapt to this role with DYE’s training and support.



As DYE plans to expand its global team with a focus on Filipino talent, this position offers the opportunity to grow into a larger role in the future.

title: Short-Form Video Editor & Content Producer — YouTube Shorts
description:
The Role



We are hiring a full-time short-form video editor and content producer to turn founder-recorded footage into polished, high-retention videos for YouTube Shorts and LinkedIn.



Our goal is to publish at least once per day. Once our editing style is established, you will help us produce approximately seven publish-ready short-form videos per week (if not more) and maintain a content buffer so we can post consistently.



This is not a basic “add captions and export” role.



You should be comfortable taking raw talking-head footage and building the supporting visual story using screen recordings, product interfaces, website screenshots, approved B-roll, animated captions, graphics, music, and sound effects. You are also expected to make the scripts so that we can create consistently high-value content on these 2 platforms around GEO/AI.



These examples show the quality and style we want:











What You’ll Do



-- Edit 30–60 second vertical videos from raw founder footage.

-- Create strong visual hooks within the first one to two seconds.

-- Remove pauses, filler, repetition, and anything that slows down the video.

-- Use frequent visual changes to hold attention without making the edit feel chaotic.

-- Combine talking-head footage with relevant screenshots, screen recordings, software interfaces, diagrams, and approved B-roll (such as AI animations from Claude Code or ChatGPT)

-- Create top-and-bottom split-screen layouts similar to the reference videos.

-- Add accurate, animated captions with highlighted keywords.

-- Use zooms, callouts, masks, highlights, and simple motion graphics to direct attention.

-- Clean and balance spoken audio, background music, and sound effects.

-- Perform basic color correction and consistent visual treatment.

-- Export upload-ready 9:16 videos for YouTube Shorts and LinkedIn so we can cross post

-- Prepare video titles, filenames, thumbnails or cover frames, and basic upload materials.

-- Organize source files, project files, and finished exports cleanly.

-- Help maintain a scheduled queue of content so publishing does not stop.

-- Suggest improvements to hooks, pacing, and visual storytelling when you see an opportunity.



What We’ll Provide



-- Raw founder footage.

-- Topic briefs, or clear content direction.

-- Brand guidelines, fonts, colors, and visual references.

-- Product screenshots and screen recordings when needed.

-- Examples of the editing style we want.

-- Direct, organized feedback.

-- A consistent workflow and the opportunity for a long-term role.



What Success Looks Like



-- Within your first 30 days:

-- You can reliably match the quality and pacing of the reference videos.

-- At least one strong edit is moving through the workflow every business day.

-- We are producing approximately seven finished videos per week.

-- First drafts are normally delivered within 24 hours.

-- Captions and technical terms are accurate.

-- Files are organized and easy for the rest of the team to find.

-- Revision rounds become smaller as you learn the brand.

-- We begin maintaining a seven-day publishing buffer.



Working Schedule



The role is designed to work asynchronously.



-- Raw footage and instructions will typically be handed off near the end of the Pacific Time workday. You can edit during normal Philippines daytime hours and return the first cut by the following Pacific morning.

-- You will not be expected to work a full overnight U.S. shift. We care more about dependable handoffs, clear communication, and meeting agreed deadlines.



How to Apply



Start your application with the words:

CHEERS DAILY



Then include:

-- A short introduction.

-- Links to your three most relevant short-form edits. Please do not send only a general portfolio homepage.

-- Which portfolio example is closest to our reference style and why.

-- How long you would expect a polished 45-second video in this style to take.

-- Your monthly salary expectation.

-- Your availability and earliest possible start date.

-- In three to five sentences, explain how you would improve retention in one of the three reference videos above.



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.

Recruit and vet creators, negotiate within set guardrails, protect our reserved discount codes, and tie spend to attributable revenue.



 marketing (10%). Own lifecycle and campaign

 marketing agency. 



PR & partnerships support (5%). Manage our PR agency (new relationship) and coordinate earned-media and collaboration opportunities that support brand awareness and revenue.



Qualifications

Strong analytical skills: comfortable interpreting Shopify sales data, ad metrics, and content performance to d

We run a daily release cadence, keep short feedback loops with customers, and stay close to how the product behaves in production once it is live. You will do well here if you are energized by shipping often, learning quickly, and making customer issues short-lived.

ARKI is interdisciplinary by design. The work sits at the intersection of PropTech and software engineering: you will partner with people who think in buildings, projects, and delivery, not only in code. Curiosity about the domain is part of the job; many problems only click once you understand how architectural firms work, and that context is a real input to how we design and ship.

You will own features end to end: partnering with customers, shaping flows, and shipping software. Some days that is React and TypeScript product work. Other days it is Python and Django APIs and data. On the desktop side it is Revit integration, threading, stability, and packaging so the web product and BIM stay in sync.



What you will do

- Ship full-stack product: Build and maintain features across React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Python, Django Ninja, and PostgreSQL

- Ship the Revit bridge: Extend and harden our C# / .NET add-in for Revit with WPF

- Scale and integrate AI: Improve performance, concurrency, and cloud workflows (Google Cloud Run, Cloud Tasks). Wire LLM and vector retrieval where the product needs intelligence.

- Stay close to users: Partner with AE firms to turn workflow pain into product on the web and inside Revit.



What we are looking for

You do not need to be senior in every area below. We expect deep strength in one of these lanes (typically full?stack web or desktop and Revit / .NET), plus a track record of learning adjacent stacks quickly and shipping with them. The rest should be meaningful experiences you can grow from, not mastery on day one.

- 5+ years of experience building production ready software. 

- Autonomy and Adaptability: A self-starter who can work through ambiguity both as an individual and collaboratively, -demonstrating a balance of independence and teamwork.

- Product-minded builder: You care about UX and outcomes, not only implementation.

- Full-stack web: Solid React and TypeScript and Python backend experience (Django or a close equivalent), PostgreSQL, and thoughtful API design.

- Desktop and plugin strength (strongly valued): Comfort shipping Windows desktop software

- Systems thinking: Debugging cross-process issues, API reliability, and performance under real customer load.

- Communication: Clear collaboration with engineers and non-technical clients.

- Education: Bachelor's in CS, engineering, or equivalent experience.

Bonus

- Experience with vector search, LLM or VLM (vision / visual language model) integrations, model fine-tuning or domain adaptation, or high-concurrency cloud backends.

- Revit API or other CAD and BIM extensibility

- CI/CD for desktop: e.g. NUKE, GitHub Actions, Inno Setup



Why Join ARKI?

A Playground for Growth: You don't need to be an expert in everything on day one. We hire for a "spike" in either web or desktop/Revit, which means we actively want to pay you to learn the other side on the job. You will emerge as a highly versatile, cross-domain engineer.

Bleeding-Edge Tech: No legacy code! You will be getting your hands dirty with applied AI, from vector search and LLMs to Vision Language Models (VLMs) solving novel problems that haven't been solved in this industry yet.

Zero Bureaucracy, High Autonomy: You won't be a cog in a massive machine. You will own entire features end-to-end, speak directly with the people using your product, and see your code go live in a matter of days.

AI-Supercharged Workflow: Because we are AI-first, we practice what we preach internally. You'll be equipped with the best AI coding tools available, allowing you to bypass boilerplate and focus entirely on the hard, interesting engineering problems.

Remote & Flexible: We trust our team. Enjoy the flexibility of a remote-first culture that values your output and impact over hours logged at a desk.

title: Email Deliverability & Domain Reputation Specialist (GHLl)

We send 50,000+ marketing/transactional
s per week and several thousand SMS messages through GoHighLevel (LC
 + LC Phone). Volume is increasing. We recently had a deliverability i
 that cost us thousands of dollars when webinar registrants stopped receiving event reminders.



We need a true expert — not a generalist
 marketer, not a funnel builder, not a "VA who has done some
." A specialist who can keep our sending infrastructure healthy, run domain warmups properly, monitor reputation daily, and catch problems *before* they cost us money.



---



What You'll Own



- Daily monitoring of domain reputation across Google Postmaster Tools, Microsoft SNDS, and blacklist services

- SPF / DKIM / DMARC configuration and ongoing alignment management

- Setting up and warming dedicated sending subdomains

- A2P 10DLC SMS campaign registration and ongoing compliance

 quickly

---

---



We pay fairly, we move quickly, and we promote people who deliver. We do not waste time on applicants who exaggerate experience — your work-sample test will expose that fast, so please apply only if you have the actual skill.



Full-time | $1,200/month to start ($1,500/month after 30-day trial with proven results)

title: Email Deliverability & Domain Reputation Specialist (GoHighLevel)

s per week and several thousand SMS messages through GoHighLevel (LC
 + LC Phone). Volume is increasing. We recently had a deliverability i
 that cost us thousands of dollars when webinar registrants stopped receiving event reminders.

 marketer, not a funnel builder, not a "VA who has done some
." A specialist who can keep our sending infrastructure healthy, run domain warmups properly, monitor reputation daily, and catch problems *before* they cost us money.



---



What You'll Own

- SPF / DKIM / DMARC configuration and ongoing alignment management

- Setting up and warming dedicated sending subdomains

- A2P 10DLC SMS campaign registration and ongoing compliance

- Diagnosing and fixing deliverability i
 quickly

- Running warmup tools (Mailreach / Warmup Inbox / Instantly / Smartlead) for new domains



---

- At least one example of a deliverability problem you diagnosed and recovered from



---

s per week. Tell me Day 1 volumes, Day 30 volumes, who you send to during warmup, and what you monitor daily.

title: Operations & Executive Assistant (Remote – Long-Term)
description:
This is not a typical assistant role.



We are building a company where AI handles the routine work, and our people handle the thinking. If you are someone who already works that way — or wants to — this role was built for you.



We are looking for an Operations & Executive Assistant who is as comfortable setting up an AI workflow as they are managing a client invoice or reconciling a vendor bill. Someone who sees a repetitive task and immediately thinks "how do I automate this" rather than "I'll just do it manually every time."



If that is how your mind works, keep reading.



~~~~~~~~~~

~About Us~

We are a Canadian Managed IT Services company supporting 225 devices across 15 business clients. We are growing fast and hiring an Operations, Accounting & Executive Assistant to help remove bottlenecks so our founder can focus on scaling the business from 225 to 500+ endpoints.



The person in this role will not just help us operate — they will help us build systems that let us scale without adding headcount at every step.



~~~~~~~~~~

~Your Mission~

Keep our operations and customers organized, our accounting accurate, our clients well-billed, and our vendor invoices reconciled — while continuously finding smarter, AI-powered ways to get more done with less manual effort.



~~~~~~~~~~

~Work Schedule~

- Full-time, 40 hours per week

- Flexible schedule with a minimum 4-hour overlap with Pacific Time (Canada)

- You choose your remaining hours within reason



~~~~~~~~~~

~Compensation~

- CAD $600 – $1,200/month depending on experience

- Paid bi-weekly

- End-of-year performance bonus tied to company growth and your contribution to it — the more you help the business grow, the more you share in that success

- Long-term role with a clear path to increased responsibility and pay



~~~~~~~~~~

~Primary Responsibilities~



~Founder Support~

- Manage and organize
 inbox

- Respond to simple client inquiries

- Schedule meetings and follow-ups

- Track action items and tasks

- Prepare weekly operations summaries



~Client Operations~

- Track client users, devices, and licenses for invoicing

- Maintain client records and documentation

- Assist with quoting clients, sourcing prices, Liason with founder and build quote, move quote to order and invoice appropriately and assist on collecting payment



~~~~~~~~~~

~Accounting & Billing — **Core Part of the Role**~

You will own the billing cycle end to end and be the first line of review on all financial activity.  As we have about 15 customers this is important work, yet not the time spent task.  

**2-4 years experience is required.**



~Invoicing & Billing~

- Review Microsoft 365 license counts via Ingram Micro before each billing cycle to ensure every license is accounted for and billed correctly to the right client

- Cross-reference Ingram Micro invoices for hardware and software purchases — confirm what was ordered, delivered, and billed to the client matches

- Prepare accurate client invoices in Wave Accounting

- Review invoice counts and amounts before invoices go out — catch errors before clients see them

- Send client statements and follow up on overdue invoices professionally



~Payments & Deposits~

- Process incoming electronic payments and match them to open client invoices in Wave Accounting

- When the owner deposits a cheque by bank scan, a photo of the cheque will be uploaded to SharePoint — you will be notified and are responsible for marking the deposit against the correct invoice in Wave

- Track all deposits and flag any discrepancies



~Credit Card & Expense Review~

- Regularly review company credit card statements

- Match charges to client accounts or internal cost categories

- Flag any unrecognized or suspicious charges as potential fraud

- Initiate disputes through the appropriate channel when required



~Accounting Inbox

- Monitor and manage the accounting inbox

- Respond to client billing questions and payment inquiries professionally

- Process vendor invoices received by

- Confirm payment receipts and send acknowledgements

- Escalate anything requiring owner decision



~~~~~~~~~~

~Operations Monitoring~

- Monitor support tickets in our Kaseya software stack

- Flag unresolved issues

- Ensure documentation is kept up to date



~~~~~~~~~~

~Growth Support~

- Maintain prospect quotes and follow up

- Help organize proposals

- Help hire and work with Marketing Manager



~~~~~~~~~~

~AI & Automation — Central to This Role~

We do not expect you to do everything manually. We expect you to figure out what AI can do, set it up, manage the output, and escalate only what needs a human decision.



- Identify repetitive tasks and build AI workflows to handle them

- Manage and review AI-generated outputs before they reach clients or the founder

- Continuously look for ways to do more with less manual effort

- Help the company build systems that scale without adding headcount



The goal is not for you to work harder. It is for you to work smarter — and help the whole company do the same.



Over time, your role will shift from doing the work to managing the systems that do the work. That is the direction we are heading, and we want someone who is excited about that future — not threatened by it.



~~~~~~~~~~

~Required Skills~

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Bookkeeping or invoicing experience — you must be comfortable working with numbers and financial records

- Experience with AI tools and automation



~~~~~~~~~~

~Helpful Experience~

- Wave Accounting or similar bookkeeping software

- Microsoft 365 and SharePoint

- PSA or ticketing systems (e.g. Kaseya)

- Distributor or vendor invoice reconciliation

- AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar)



~~~~~~~~~~

~Tools We Use~

- Wave Accounting

- Ingram Micro distributor portal

- Kaseya software stack

- Microsoft 365 and SharePoint

- PSA / ticketing systems

- Spreadsheets and documentation tools

- AI tools — and we are always adding more



~~~~~~~~~~

~Personality We Are Looking For~

- Extremely organized

- Detail-focused — billing errors cost us money and client trust

- Proactive problem solver — you fix things before being asked

- Calm and dependable

- Trustworthy with financial information

- Genuinely excited about building better systems

- You see AI as a tool that makes you more powerful, not a threat to your job

- Reliable, consistent, and self-managed



~~~~~~~~~~

~Weekly Report You Will Own~

- Invoices sent

- Payments received and deposits processed

- Overdue invoices and follow-up status

- Credit card review status and any flagged charges

- Operational issues needing attention

- Priorities for the coming week



~~~~~~~~~~

~Long-Term Opportunity~

As AI takes over more of the routine work, this role grows with it. Your path could lead to:



- Operations Manager

- Finance Coordinator

- Automation & Process Manager



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us for years, not months — and who wants to be part of building something, not just maintaining it.



~~~~~~~~~~

~How to Apply~

To be considered, your application must include all four of the following:



1. Your experience with operations, admin, or bookkeeping — be specific about what you did

2. The tools you have used — software, platforms, and AI tools

3. A specific example of how you have used AI to save time or improve a process

4. An example of a time you caught a billing or financial error before it became a problem



~Bonus Task — complete this to stand out:~

Review the following client billing summary:



Client A | 12 devices | 10 licenses billed | 12 on record | Oct 1 | Unpaid | 45 days overdue

Client B | 8 devices | 8 licenses billed | 8 on record | Oct 15 | Paid

Client C | 22 devices | 22 licenses billed | 25 on record | Sept 15 | Unpaid | 60 days overdue

Client D | 5 devices | 5 licenses billed | 5 on record | Oct 20 | Paid

Client E | 17 devices | 20 licenses billed | 17 on record | Oct 1 | Unpaid | 45 days overdue



Answer these three questions:



1. Which clients have a billing discrepancy and what is the issue with each?

2. Which clients need immediate payment follow-up and why?

3. How would you use an AI tool to automate the overdue invoice follow-up process so you are managing it rather than writing each
 manually? Describe your approach in 2-3 sentences.



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.

title: Outbound Cold Caller – Australian B2B (Neutral/American Accent Required)
description:
We're an Australian AI automation agency. You'll be cold calling Australian business owners to book discovery meetings for us. Straight outbound dialling — no inbound, no chat support, no admin.



**READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING**



This role calls Australian business owners who hang up fast. You need to sound neutral or American on the phone. If your accent is noticeably Filipino, please don't apply.  We will reject you and it wastes both our time. Be honest with yourself here.



**What you'll do**

- 100+ outbound dials per day using our dialler 

- Work Manila 7am-3pm (Melbourne 9am-5pm). Non-negotiable, these are the only hours that work.

- Book qualified meetings into our calendar

- Log every call outcome in our CRM



**What you need**

- 2+ years outbound calling on a US, UK, or Australian account at a real business 

- Outbound sales or appointment setting specifically. nNot inbound customer service

- Wired internet connection (not WiFi) and a proper USB headset

- Backup power/internet arrangement

- You can handle rejection all day without going flat by 11am



**HOW TO APPLY - follow this exactly or you'll be rejected**



Do not send a CV or a generic intro video. Send a single audio recording, roughly 90 seconds, with these three parts:



1. **(30 sec)** Read this script word for word:

*"Hi, is that [name]? My name's ___, I was just reaching out because we build AI automation systems for Australian businesses to replace admin tasks. Have you looked at anything like that before?"*



2. **(30 sec)** In your own words, unscripted: why would a business owner want to take this call?



3. **(30 sec)** Unscripted: respond to a prospect saying *"I'm not interested, we already have someone doing that."*



Also tell us in your message:

- Which businesses you've worked (company + region)

- Your internet setup (wired or WiFi, speed, backup plan)



Applications without the audio recording will not be read. Applications that only include part 1 will not be read.



**What happens next**

Shortlisted candidates do a live call with us, then a paid trial on real dials before any ongoing arrangement.

This is a new position created by growth. We need someone to handle bookkeeping and to calculate and track sales commissions.



Hours & schedule

~20 hours per week to start, with room to grow. Training calls happen at 3:00 PM Utah time, which is 5:00 AM the following day in the Philippines. (Utah changes clocks twice a year, so this becomes 6:00 AM Manila from November through March.) Outside of training, hours are flexible.



Pay

$80–$100 USD per week, paid weekly. Rate depends on experience.



Requirements



Degree or formal coursework in accounting, or equivalent bookkeeping experience

Strong Google Sheets skills — this is where most of the work happens

Excel

Solid understanding of debits and credits

Able to reconcile a bank account independently

Careful, accurate work with numbers
