title: Personal Operations & AI Assistant
description:
I’m looking for someone who genuinely enjoys creating order out of chaos.



I own an interior design business, have a busy household, two kids with active schedules, and lots of moving pieces. I’m building a comprehensive personal and household operations system and am looking for someone who loves organizing information, improving workflows, and finding better ways to get things done.



This is not a traditional executive assistant role. I’m looking for someone who enjoys problem-solving, technology, AI, automation, and building systems that make life and business run more smoothly.



No two weeks will look exactly the same. Some weeks we’ll be building systems, other weeks we’ll be solving problems, researching solutions, coordinating projects, or improving existing workflows. I love new ideas, and I’m looking for someone who enjoys helping turn those ideas into organized, actionable plans.



Some projects may include:



• Organizing and maintaining Airtable databases

• Researching and implementing AI tools and automations

• Building workflows using platforms like Make, Zapier, or similar tools

• Creating and documenting systems and standard operating procedures (SOPs)

• Organizing digital files and information

• Researching products, services, and solutions

• Simplifying recurring tasks and processes

• Managing task lists and following up to ensure projects are completed

• Working closely with my Executive House Manager to prioritize projects, communicate updates, and keep everyone aligned

• Helping coordinate a small team of household support staff so projects continue moving without me having to oversee every detail

• Occasionally communicating with vendors, contractors, and service providers

• Scheduling appointments and assisting with logistics

• Looking for creative ways to save time, reduce mental load, and improve how everything operates



The ideal person is:



• Highly organized and detail-oriented

• Curious about AI, automation, and emerging technology

• Comfortable learning new software quickly

• A strong written and verbal communicator

• Proactive and able to work independently

• Comfortable coordinating multiple people and keeping projects on track

• Someone who enjoys improving processes instead of simply following them

• Comfortable switching between different types of projects

• Able to think several steps ahead and anticipate what needs to happen next



Experience with AI tools, ChatGPT, Airtable, Notion, Make, Zapier, Google Workspace, or similar productivity platforms is a huge plus. More important than experience with any one platform is a willingness to learn, adapt, and continuously improve systems.



A little about me…



I’m a very creative, big-picture thinker with an ADHD brain, which means I’m constantly coming up with new ideas and opportunities. I’m looking for someone who enjoys taking those ideas, helping prioritize them, creating structure around them, and turning them into actionable plans. If you love organizing, creating systems, and bringing clarity to moving pieces, you’ll probably enjoy working with me.



This position will begin on a project basis as we build these systems together. You can expect approximately 5–10 hours per week to start, although that may vary depending on current projects and priorities. If we’re a great fit, there is absolutely potential for this to grow into a long-term role with increasing responsibility, hours, and compensation.



Ultimately, I’m looking for someone who becomes a trusted operations partner…someone who enjoys building systems, improving processes, and helping bring ideas to life while keeping everything running smoothly behind the scenes.



If you’re the type of person who gets excited about making complicated things simple, I’d love to hear from you!



When you apply, please include:

• A little about yourself

• Any experience with AI or automation tools

• Your hourly rate and general availability
